cues: Start with the simplest green life there is: Chlamydomonas, a single cell swimming in a pond.
It photosynthesises, it absorbs, it moves, and it reproduces.
text: Start with the simplest green life there is: Chlamydomonas, a single cell swimming in a pond. That one cell does everything. It photosynthesises, it absorbs, it moves, and it reproduces.
